name: Hetaera's Clutch
summary: Hetaera's brood now nests among the drowned ruins beneath Azshara's Bay of Storms. Once, night elves came to this temple to worship Elune.

sections.title: A Drowned Sanctuary
sections.body: Before the Great Sundering broke ancient Kalimdor apart, night elves came to this temple to worship Elune. The sanctuary sank beneath the Bay of Storms, where its pillars and halls have rested under the sea for ten thousand years. Now the tides cover every sign of worship, and the Kaldorei ruins lie below the waves.

sections.title: Domain of the Broodmother
sections.body: Hetaera makes her nest in the drowned sanctuary. The massive hydra has many heads and stalks the nearby coastal waters and rocky isles. Her offspring, the Spawn of Hetaera, prowl the ruined arches and corridors. They attack any surface-dweller bold enough to dive into the bay.

faq.q: What was Hetaera's Clutch originally built for?
faq.answer: Before sinking, Hetaera's Clutch was a temple dedicated to Elune, the moon goddess. It was built at the height of the ancient night elven empire and sank into the ocean during the Great Sundering.
Hetaera's Clutch rests deep beneath the Bay of Storms, off Azshara's jagged southern coast.

Hetaera is a three-headed hydra that prowls Azshara's waters. Her children infest the sunken temple, while she is usually found swimming just north of the Clutch or basking on nearby offshore islands.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the submerged ruins?
aliases: what mobs are in hetaeras clutch
faq.answer: Hetaera's brood inhabits the drowned halls. These vicious aquatic hydras defend their nesting site against intruders who swim too close.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may see the drowned sanctuary of Elune, now a hydra nest, as a reminder of the civilization lost in the Sundering.
As a druid exploring the Bay of Storms, beware the hydras claiming this ancient sanctuary. They are hostile to trespassers.
